gas.method: Publish was simulated on Sui Mainnet through Tatum with mocked gas: 76,670,000 MIST gross. Other caps use measured Testnet gross upper bounds at Mainnet reference gas price 100 MIST, rounded up to explicit per-transaction limits. The native-USDC x402 library path is gasless at 0.80 USDC and sets facilitator gas budget to zero. Authorization is the sum of transaction limits, not an estimate of actual charges; actual computation, storage and rebates must be recorded separately.
